newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices fall on lack of demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices fall on lack of demand.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices fell on low demand at the weekly auction, brokers said.

Buyers for Poland were active for bold and large brokens, but there was less support from Pakistan and Afghanistan resulting in price fall for smaller brokens and fannings. Local buyers and blenders were also less active. "The action was held with big participation despite Monday's cyclone that battered Chittagong and many coastal districts," one broker said.
The average price was 62.2 per kg, down 1.45 from the previous sale. Some 696,063 kg were sold. The next sale will be held on May 27 with an offer of 1.15 million kg of teas.
